problem.title: Divide Chocolate
problem.problemStatement: A chocolate bar is represented by an array of sweetness values. Divide it into K+1 contiguous pieces by making exactly K cuts. Maximize the minimum sweetness among all pieces.
problem.input: • First line contains integers N and K. • Second line contains N integers representing sweetness values.
problem.output: Print the maximum possible minimum sweetness.
